Frontend Developer

Join our design-focused product team to build fast, accessible interfaces used by thousands of small businesses.

Responsibilities
- Build responsive, accessible user interfaces with React and TypeScript
- Translate Figma designs into reusable components in our design system
- Manage application state and integrate with REST and GraphQL APIs
- Improve web performance and Core Web Vitals
- Write unit and end-to-end tests

Requirements
- 1+ years of experience in frontend development
- Strong JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML and CSS skills
- Production experience with React
- Understanding of accessibility (WCAG) and responsive design
- Experience with Git and code reviews

Nice to have
- Next.js, Tailwind CSS or Redux
- Experience with Jest or Playwright
